name: cfcmt-bus-iql-execution-signal-v1
gradient_definition: At fixed checkpoints: negative recorded-action log likelihood times actual detached IQL weights. Each group contribution sums per-record gradients divided by overall selected N, so free plus forced contributions equal full-data gradient. No optimizer steps; gradient norms do not imply independent causal contributions.
diagnostics: Execution-projected deterministic actions and gate decisions before/after entropy-OFF; current-state free and forced groups.
Actual IQL advantages, cap/near-zero weights, ESS/N and five-actor cross weighted NLL within each fixed weight row.
Raw recorded-likelihood actor gradients in free and forced60 states; forced execution has constant action60 regardless of desired distribution.
Recorded, projected-zero and five deterministic actor actions under each learned min-Q critic; changed free-action rankings are estimates, not true outcomes.
admission: Actual seed75101/64 evenly spaced fit rows through native critic/weights/log likelihood and projection. Check finite outputs, group gradient/loss addition and deterministic forced invariance. No simulated control or parameter update.
limits: Original fit states only; no new data, interaction, threshold, hyperparameter or checkpoint selection.
Frozen learned Q scores and NLL are not real counterfactual action costs.
Current checkpoint gradients are not integrated historical update attribution; gradient norm ratios are not additive percentages.
Collapsed-state latent gradient can be irrelevant to executed policy without proving it caused the cost gap.
code_boundary: Only CFCMT-owned frozen runtime; no mutable Thesis import or access. Code/JSON/log only; no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
